From a Spark to a Gentleman

How a simple white sparkle on black became a character with a wardrobe, a pocket watch, and impeccable manners.

Look closely at the SupaNova mark and you will see it is no ordinary star. Its four points sweep inward with concave curves, and one point — the lower-left — stretches out far longer and sharper than the rest, like the tail of a comet caught mid-flight. It is less a shape than a gesture: a flash, a wink, a flourish.

Novas keeps that silhouette exactly as his head. The long lower-left spike, the tall upper-right point, the two shorter companions — all present, all accounted for. What the ink added was everything below the neck: a feathered top hat, a tailcoat cut to perfection, and the unhurried confidence of a gentleman who has never once been late for anything.

He is drawn the old way — fine black linework, patient cross-hatching, warm sepia ink on paper that has already lived a long life. No two plates catch him in quite the same mood, but the manners never slip. Not even mid-leap.

The Mark of Origin

The SupaNova sparkle, exactly as it appears in the logo. Novas's head is this silhouette, unchanged — the character is the logo, brought to life.

  • Lower-left spikeThe longest point — his signature flourish, kept at full length.
  • Upper-right pointTall and keen, the second-longest of the four.
  • Side pointsShorter and modest, balancing the silhouette.
  • Concave curvesEach side bows inward, giving the head its unmistakable sparkle profile.

The Feathered Top Hat

Tall, polished, and never — ever — worn straight. The feather is non-negotiable.

The Bow Tie

Tied fresh every morning. The true mark of a sparkle who takes himself seriously.

The Pocket Watch

Always on time — a star that rose in a flash knows the value of a moment.

The Umbrella

Carried closed, always. Part cane, part rapier, entirely a fashion statement.
